rationale: Static explicit power law Prad = f(q,a,psi,theta_obs) with fixed physical/shape constants. No derivatives or integrals (analyze_expression: max_derivative_order=0, no kernels), target only on LHS and explicitly solvable -> equation_type=explicit, integrator=evaluate_explicit. Independent axes q,a,psi,theta_obs match the pipeline labels and are the variables Prad genuinely depends on; all other free symbols are constants fixed to physically sensible values. pi is a numeric constant, not fixed as a parameter. Parameter choices keep the relativistic factor real (beta in ~0.07..0.7) while placing a_crit inside the a-range and using chi_qed=1, omega_c=1e12 so every factor - and the new QED saturation term in particular - is well above the noise (new term 5830x sigma).

scenario_text: An accelerating charged particle radiates electromagnetic power that grows with the square of its acceleration. We examine the instantaneous radiated power for particles undergoing different accelerations. The particle charge sets an overall prefactor. Each measurement is an independent snapshot of emission at a given acceleration.
